# QR encoder

Nayuki QR Code generator, MIT license (retained in the source header).

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/9a217d443937f60cc56c1458c39a211d7f2d3af5/typescript-javascript/qrcodegen.ts

Local change: export the namespace as an ES module for lazy loading. QR codes are generated locally; no coordinates are sent to a QR service.
